title: Low-frequency audiogram slope does not establish incremental prediction of balance-test failure across NHANES samples
abstract: In 517 complete-case NHANES 2003–2004 adults aged 40–69, adding binaural low-frequency audiogram slope did not establish improved balance-failure prediction beyond conventional hearing summaries and risk factors: Brier gain +0.00138960, source/target PSU-refit 95% interval −0.00841561 to +0.00585358.
